room_rent.note: Room rent eligibility not stated in policy wording; likely defined in Policy Schedule

icu.note: ICU charges covered under in-patient expenses but no cap/limit stated in wording; defined in Policy Schedule

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.note: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; domiciliary hospitalisation capped at 10% of Basic SI; organ donor, laser eye surgery, obesity, infertility, maternity limits per schedule; ambulance per schedule

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible; hospital daily cash and nursing allowance have a 48-hour deductible but that is benefit-specific

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Policy states 36 or 24 months depending on plan chosen; base is 36 months

specific_disease_waiting.note: Cataract, hernia, piles etc. 12 mo; joint replacement, calculus diseases 24 mo; obesity surgery, infertility 36 mo

maternity.note: Inbuilt under Part D.17; separate SI from Basic SI; max 2 deliveries lifetime; 24-month waiting period; child care, newborn vaccinations, screening and cord blood banking also included

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of Basic SI per claim-free year up to 100%; optional Cumulative Bonus Enhancer add-on increases to 25%/yr up to 150%

restoration.note: Restored SI = 100% of Basic SI; triggered after Basic SI + CB exhausted; cannot be used for same illness for which claim was paid in current year; unused amount lapses at year end; total restored SI cannot exceed Basic SI in a year

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation cover exists but number of days is stated in the Policy Schedule, not in the wording

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation cover exists but number of days is stated in the Policy Schedule, not in the wording

day_care.note: Extensive list of 405+ named day-care procedures across specialties covered

domiciliary.note: Covered if patient cannot be moved or no hospital bed available; condition must last ≥3 days; capped at 10% of Basic SI; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to Basic SI; OPD/day care AYUSH excluded; pre/post hospitalisation AYUSH excluded

organ_donor.note: Donor screening and harvesting expenses covered up to limit in schedule; donor pre/post-hospitalisation not covered

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered; air ambulance via emergency assistance services (cashless, 150km+ from home); exact road ambulance limit in Policy Schedule

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables/external devices explicitly excluded; no consumables rider mentioned

global_cover.note: Worldwide coverage available as optional cover; emergency inpatient only; reimbursement in INR; PED excluded for first 36 months; max 180 days/year outside India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; includes portability/migration credits

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly instalment; coverage available during grace period if premium paid in instalments

free_look.note: Applicable only for new individual policies; not on renewals or policies with tenure less than 1 year

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; credits for PED and specific waiting periods transferable

notable_exclusions.display: STDs/HIV, dental (non-accident), spectacles/hearing aids, external prosthetics, external congenital anomaly, self-harm, OPD (except pre/post-hosp), treatment outside India (unless optional cover)

optional_riders.display: Cumulative Bonus Enhancer (up to 150%), OPD cover, Critical Illness & PA cover (9 CIs + AD/PTD/PPD), Adventure Sports cover, Worldwide coverage
